recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Do not add redundant profilelist prose or impose a stricter difference-only rendering rule from this old tracker; any stronger rule for IG Publisher or profile differential normalization should be handled as a new tooling/work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-6189 was a Published FHIR-core change request asking that profile differential views show only what is different and remove unchanged material; the accepted Persuasive with Modification resolution said this had largely been done while preserving editor discretion over differential-view content.
initial_application: No fixed-string FHIR-6189 implementation commit was found. Current application appears through the profile presentation template and profiling documentation, including the separate differential table and the explanation that contextual information not in the differential may be shown partially transparent.
additional_context: The seed comments referenced CDA R2 profiles and FHIR-6190; current source/fhir.ini comments out the old cda profile entry, so that source is not an active current-build profile target. A later Zulip discussion about unchanged content in differentials confirms that authoring and rendering sometimes need repeated or contextual material and that automatic stripping is nuanced.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current source defines differentials as sparse statements of differences, separates Differential View from Full Structure, and explicitly permits contextual display rows, which matches the Jira's modified resolution.

related_jiras.note: The seed comment pointed to this separate Clinical Document/CDA profile cleanup issue; it helped confirm the old CDA profile source is out of current build scope but was not needed to decide FHIR-6189.
